Dark aesthetic honored via a #0a1220->#0f2038 vertical gradient; a three-layer SVG wave motif occupies the bottom band and never overlaps type. Contrast is strong throughout (title 15.96:1, speaker 13.62:1, dept 8.01:1, divider accent 6.48:1) and all font sizes clear the presentation floor (76px / 30px / 24px). Report confirms scrollW/scrollH exactly 1280x720 with no overflow, no clipping, and console.log is empty; t0 and t2 are byte-equivalent, correct for a static slide. Two minor defects hold this below a clean pass: a cusp artifact where the top wave path hooks back at the right border and a frequency break in the second path, plus a vertical-centering mismatch where the content box assumes a 540px wave line while the waves actually begin near y=630, pushing the text block ~45px high and leaving a noticeable dead gap.
